entities.summary: Christopher Hikaru Nakamura is a Japanese-American chess grandmaster, streamer, YouTuber, five-time U.S. Chess Champion, Louisiana state champion 2025, and the 2022 World Fischer Random Chess Champion. A chess prodigy, he earned his grandmaster title at the age of 15, the youngest American at the time to do so. With a peak rating of 2816, Nakamura is tied as the tenth-highest-rated player in history.
